output.rule: Use 是……吗, V不V, or a Wh-question for an indirect question, not 如果. For “wh-ever…, will do that…”, repeat the Wh-word: 哪一筐……就……哪一筐.
output.explanation_template: <wrong> → <correct>: this asks <whether/what/where>, so use <question pattern>, not 如果.

examples.explanation: 如果 → 是: “see if” asks whether it is poison or medicine, so use 是……还是……, not 如果.
如果有毒 → 有没有毒: “not know if” asks whether it is poisonous, so use a V不V question, not 如果.
从哪里由此而来 → 从何而来: this asks where it comes from, so use a “where” question; 由此而来 means “come from this”.
梨子的筐 → 哪一筐: for “whichever basket has more pears, put that basket...”, repeat 哪一筐 in the result clause.
